name: Mediterranean Chicken Bowl
description: Mediterranean Chicken Bowl with high-protein balanced ingredients.
steps: Rinse quinoa thoroughly and cook it in salted water for 12–15 minutes.
Season chicken with oregano, garlic, salt and pepper.
Grill chicken over medium heat until golden and fully cooked.
Let chicken rest before slicing into strips.
Dice cucumber and halve cherry tomatoes.
Place quinoa in a bowl and layer vegetables on top.
Add sliced chicken and spoon tzatziki over everything.
Finish with olive oil and herbs.

name: Mexican Beef Rice Bowl
description: Mexican Beef Rice Bowl with high-protein balanced ingredients.
steps: Cook rice until soft and fluffy.
Season beef with cumin, paprika, salt and chili.
Cook beef in a hot pan until browned.
Warm black beans and corn separately.
Slice avocado into thin pieces.
Assemble rice, beef, beans and corn in a bowl.
Top with avocado and serve warm.

name: Asian Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
description: Asian Teriyaki Chicken Bowl with high-protein balanced ingredients.
steps: Cook rice until fluffy and set aside.
Steam broccoli and carrots until tender but crisp.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Pan-fry chicken until browned and cooked through.
Add teriyaki sauce and glaze the chicken.
Combine rice, vegetables, and chicken in a bowl.
Pour remaining sauce over the top and serve.

name: Salmon Power Bowl

Arrange sweet potato in a bowl.
